headword: {厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}
gloss: state of maximum alert; tight security

definitions.gloss: state of maximum alert; tight security
definitions.explanation: Strict, heightened security in which police or other authorities are fully deployed and on guard, as for a summit meeting, a major event, or after an attack or disaster warning. A news word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}だ。
examples.english: The venue is under tight security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: The police put maximum security in place.

examples.japanese: {首脳会議|しゅのうかいぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間中|きかんちゅう}→期間中：23950_kikanchuu⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: During the summit, tight security was in force around the station.

notes:
{厳戒|げんかい} (strict watch) + ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧ (readiness). The stronger form of ⟦{警戒態勢|けいかいたいせい}→警戒態勢：33358_keikaitaisei⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to put maximum security in place
- {厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to go on maximum alert
- {厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: amid tight security
- {厳戒態勢|げんかいたいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the high alert continues
